name: Necromancer Ner'zhul's Blessing raises maximum Runic Power by 20% (#1224)
contract: Ner'zhul's Blessing 704729 is a Class-tab node (CharacterAdvancement 31143, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 87, AbilityEssenceCost 1, SpellFamilyName 29) whose description reads 'Increases your maximum Runic Power by $s1%.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT (132) MiscValue 6 (POWER_RUNIC_POWER), BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = 20; its ProcFlags 4 has no proc effect to trigger. The aura is not 42/354, so the Necromancer load contract leaves it intact, and AuraEffect::HandleAuraModIncreaseEnergyPercent applies it to UNIT_MOD_RUNIC_POWER TOTAL_PCT, which Player::UpdateMaxPower multiplies into the maximum. Expected: learning the talent multiplies maximum Runic Power by exactly 1.2 and leaves maximum mana unchanged; unlearning restores the original maximum.
